name: PERF-FACE-a-a-drawn-face-reported-clean
old: this._faceDyn[k * 6 + face] = drew > 0 ? 1 : 0;   // PERF-FACE: a face no dynamic drew into is the cache again
new: this._faceDyn[k * 6 + face] = 0;   // PERF-FACE: a face no dynamic drew into is the cache again

name: PERF-FACE-b-a-fresh-cache-under-a-mover-copied-by-face
old: this._blitSlot(k, f.bindVao, staticStale ? FACES_ALL : this._dirtyFaces(k));   // CACHE-COPY: by a draw; PERF-FACE: only the faces that hold more than the cache
new: this._blitSlot(k, f.bindVao, this._dirtyFaces(k));   // CACHE-COPY: by a draw; PERF-FACE: only the faces that hold more than the cache

name: PERF-FACE-c-a-fresh-cache-with-nothing-moving-copied-by-face
old: this._blitSlot(k, f.bindVao, staticStale ? FACES_ALL : this._dirtyFaces(k));   // PERF-FACE: a face that holds the cache already is left
new: this._blitSlot(k, f.bindVao, this._dirtyFaces(k));   // PERF-FACE: a face that holds the cache already is left

name: PERF-FACE-d-an-emptied-slot-trusted
old: this._slotSelf[k] = 0; this._faceDyn.fill(1, k * 6, k * 6 + 6); }   // an emptied slot is drawn afresh when it is filled
new: this._slotSelf[k] = 0; this._faceDyn.fill(0, k * 6, k * 6 + 6); }   // an emptied slot is drawn afresh when it is filled
why: An emptied slot's cache flag is cleared beside it (_slotCached 0), so the slot's next use is staticStale and copies FACES_ALL whatever its faces say - the fill is the invariant written down, not a law any frame can reach.
